text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki was injured during training,
so we rushed over to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oof... It seems the injury
is in worse shape than I had expected...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However, even if it brings pain, I must keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
They say that even fire is cool if you clear your mind,
so please let me continue my training.
choice_data_list: Let's train properly once you've fully recovered.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'll be careful to run without putting too much strain on myself.
So please, I beg of you—
choice_data_list: You might pick up some bad habits in your form.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Forcing the training might actually set them back instead...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. I will behave myself and recuperate quietly until I make a full recovery."

Yaeno Muteki spoke with regret
as she returned to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your understanding...!
Let's head out to the track right away!

I had Yaeno Muteki run lightly just to see how she was doing,
but she still grimaced in pain.
choice_data_list: Let's cancel today's training after all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...I am truly sorry. Taking you up on your kind offer,
I will take the day off to rest..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Such an unsightly display...
It's so embarrassing..."

Yaeno Muteki seemed to be in considerable pain,
walking slowly back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Phew... As long as it's exercise that doesn't put too much strain on me, there shouldn't be any problem.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Until I am fully recovered,
I will continue my training at this pace!

Yaeno Muteki kept her injury in mind
and trained within reasonable limits.
